pe4:2.1: tattha kusalehi dhammehi akusalehi dhammehi pubbāparaso sādhukaṃ uparikkhīyati
pe4:2.2: kiṃ nu kho idaṃ suttaṃ ārabhi …pe… tehi suttehi saha adhisannaṭṭhehi yujjati, udāhu na yujjatīti.
pe4:3.1: yathā bhagavā kilese ādimhi tattha deseti,
pe4:3.3: tesaṃ kilesānaṃ pahānaṃ udāhu no desitanti upaparikkhitabbaṃ:
pe4:3.4: yadi na desitaṃ bhagavatā tesaṃ kilesānaṃ pahānaṃ, kusalā dhammā pariyesitabbā.
pe4:3.7: tattha akusalā dhammā apakaḍḍhitabbā vimaṃsitabbā saṃkilesabhāgiyasuttaṃ. yadi kilesā apakaḍḍhiyantā.
pe4:3.8: ye vā na denti. tattha upaparikkhitabbā ariyamaggadhammā, tāsu bhūmisu kilesā pahānaṃ gacchanti, udāhu na gacchantīti.
pe4:3.11: yattha kilesā pahānaṃ gacchanti, tattha ye kilesā ariyadhammānaṃ paṭipakkhena na yujjanti, te apakaḍḍhitabbā, sace apakaḍḍhiyantā yojanaṃ deti,
pe4:3.13: dve tīṇi vā taduttariṃ vā kilesā ekena ariyamaggena pahānaṃ gacchantīti.
pe4:3.14: sace evaṃ vīmaṃsiyantā yojanaṃ deti, tattha upaparikkhitabbaṃ:
pe4:3.15: paramparāya vā piṭakasampadānena vā suttassa attho ca nattho ca
pe4:3.16: yaṃ vā na sakkā suttaṃ niddisituṃ, neva suttaṃ vicikicchitabbaṃ,
pe4:3.17: evaṃ yathā ādimhi kusalā dhammā honti,
pe4:3.20: puro vā kusalo paṭipakkhena vā puro desanā, anūnā anadhikā uggahetabbā.
pe4:3.21: yathā paṭhamo uttilo [?] yesamidāni kilesānaṃ ye ariyadhammā desitā ime kilesā imehi ariyadhammehi pahīyanti, udāhu na pahīyantīti vicīnitabbā.
pe4:3.23: atha na yujjanti, ye kilesā apaṭipakkhā honti, te kilesā aparipakkhitabbā.
pe4:3.24: ye ca ariyadhammā paṭipakkhā honti, te ariyadhammā apakaḍḍhitabbā.
pe4:3.25: na hi ariyadhammā anāgāmī kilesappahānaṃ gacchanti, nāpi ariyadhammā sabbakilesānaṃ pahānāya saṃvattanti.
pe4:3.26: yathā kusalā mettā, akusalo rāgo, na tu kusalā mettāti katvā akusalassa rāgassa pahānāya sambhavati. byāpādo mettāya pahānaṃ gacchati.
pe4:3.28: yo yo ca dhammo upadisīyati kusalo vā akusalo vā, so apakaḍḍhitabebā.
pe4:3.29: sace te yujjanti apakaḍḍhiyamāno natthi upaparikkhitabbaṃ.
pe4:3.30: dvo vā kilesā ekena ariyadhammena pahīneyyāti dvīhi vā ariyadhammehi eko vā kileso pahīyatīti.
pe4:4.1: atha vā evampi uparikkhiyamānaṃ yujjati, tattha vīmaṃsitabbaṃ vā yathā yujjati tattha vīmaṃsitabbaṃ vā, yathā nanu sakkā suttaṃ niddisituṃ, na hi sutte vicikicchitabbaṃ.
pe4:4.2: kileso maṃ ariyadhammesu desitesu ubhayato upaparikkhitabbaṃ: ye vā
pe4:4.3: kira. ime kilesā desitā ye ca ariyadhammā desitā gāthāya vā byākaraṇena vā, kiṃ nu kho ime kilesā imehi ariyadhammehi pahīyanti, udāhu na pahīyanti,
pe4:4.4: ime vā pana ariyadhammā imesaṃ kilesānaṃ pahānāya saṃvattantīti.
pe4:4.5: tiñcāpi kusalehi dhammehi akusalā dhammā pahānaṃ gacchanti
pe4:4.6: na tu sabbehi sabbā’kusalā pahānaṃ gacchanti,
pe4:4.7: yathā mettā kusalā akusalo ca rāgo, na tu kusalā mettā akusalo rāgoki katvā mettāya rāgo pahānaṃ. byāpādo mettāya pahānaṃ gacchati.
pe4:4.8: evaṃ kilesoti katvā suttena pahānaṃ gacchati,
pe4:4.9: na sutto dhammoti katvā, sabbassa kilesassa pahānāya saṃvattati,
pe4:4.10: yaṃ tu suttassa ariyadhammo saṃkilesapaṭipakkho so tena pahānaṃ gacchatīti.
pe4:5.1: tattha kusale desite sutte byākaraṇe vā saṃkilesā na yujjanti ariyadhammā vā, te mahāpadese niddisitabbāvayavena apakaḍḍhitabbā
pe4:5.2: tattha kilesehi ca desitehi ariyadhammesu ca yadipi tena ariyadhammena te kilesā pahānaṃ gacchanti,
pe4:5.4: kena kāraṇena ete kilesā pajahitabbā, kena kāraṇena ariyadhammā desitāti.
pe4:5.5: yena yena vā ākārena ariyadhammā desitā tena tena pakārena ayaṃ kileso ṭhito.
pe4:5.6: atthi hi eko kileso tena vā ariyadhammo na aññathā, aññathā pahātabbo, yathā diṭṭhirāgo avijjā ca dassanena pahātabbā.
pe4:5.7: sā ce evaṃ ca avijjā bhāvanāya bhūmi vā dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
pe4:5.8: sāyeva uddhambhāgiyaṃ asaṅkhatadassanāya vimuttiyā animittena cetosamādhinā amanasikārena pahīyati.
pe4:5.10: ye dassanena pahātabbā kilesā dassanākārena ariyadhammo desito. bhāvanāya pahātabbā bhāvanākārena ariyadhammo desito. patisevanā pahātabbā patisevanākārena ariyadhammo desito, evaṃ vinodanā pahātabbā yāva satta āsavā kātabbā, yāvaññathā.
pe4:5.11: aññathā hesa dhammo pahātabbo aññenākerena ariyadhammo desito, so ariyadhammo aññathā pariyesitabbo.
pe4:5.12: yadi ayaṃ dhammo pariyesato yo ca deseti yena yenākārena, so ariyadhammo pariyesitabbo, tenākārena kileso pahīyati
pe4:5.14: atha na yujjati yadi hi tena suttena vihitaṃ, suttaṃ vīmaṃsitabbaṃ,
pe4:5.16: yathā na yujjati, tathā na gahetabbaṃ, addhā etaṃ bhagavatā na bhāsitaṃ, āyasmatā vā duggahitaṃ, yathā mahāpadese niddiyitabbaṃ, bhagavatā yathābhūtaṃ desitaṃ, yo ca dhammo desito kusalo ca akusalo ca tassa dhammassa paccayo pariyesitabbo,
pe4:5.17: na hi paccayā vinā dhammo appaccayo uppajjati.
pe4:6.1: tattha tathārūpaṃ sahetu sappaccayaṃ soyaṃ dhammo vuttoti idaṃ vīmaṃsitabbaṃ.
pe4:6.4: tattha mudumhi paccayo mudu dhammo gahetabbo, evaṃ satyesa paccayo duvidho: paramparapaccayo ca samanantarapaccayo ca.
pe4:6.5: so paccayo mudu tena vemattataṃ pariyesitabbaṃ.
pe4:6.7: aññataropi paccayo aññehi paccayehi pariyattiṃ vā pāripūriṃ vā gacchati.
pe4:6.8: tattha yo dhammo desito, tassa dhammassa etena vā kāraṇena vā hetu pariyesitabbo.
pe4:6.9: yathā paccayo hetunā paccayena ca, so tassa dhammassa nissando pariyesitabbo.
pe4:6.10: yathā niddiṭṭho adhiṭṭhāne padhānaṃ pariyesati, so paccayo pariyesitabbo.
pe4:6.11: na hi mudussa dhammassa adhimatto nissando adhimattassa vā nissandassa mudu dhammo, atha mudussa mudu, majjhāya majjho, adhimattassa adhimatto yujjati, taṃ gahetabbaṃ. atha na yujjati na gahetabbaṃ.
pe4:6.12: yaṃ va bhagavā ārabhati dhammaṃ desetuṃ, taṃ yeva dhammaṃ majjhaṃ taṃ pariyosānaṃ deseti, yathā suttādhiṭṭhāne dhamme ādimhi niddisati, taṃyeva pahūtassa suttassa pariyosānaṃ
pe4:6.13: tassa hi dhammassa vasena taṃ suttaṃ hoti gāthā vā byākāraṇaṃ khuddakaṃ mahantaṃ vā yathā pana duvidhā anurūpanti vā ṭhapanā ca desanāṭhapanā.
pe4:6.15: yathā ca bhagavatā pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ desitaṃ taṇhāya niggahaṇatthā icchāva hoti.
pe4:6.16: deseti yathā gopālakupame sutte aññehi pi suttehi bhagavā bhāsati icchāva hoti, majjhimanikāye vitakko. ayaṃ bhagavato desanānurūpanti, iti so dhammo aññesupi veyyākaraṇesu pariyesitabbo.
pe4:6.17: na hi ekaṃ hi sutte daṭṭhabbo
pe4:7.2: yaṃ kiñci suttaṃ bhagavatā na bhāsitaṃ, taṃ ca suttesu yeva dissati, evametaṃ dhāretabbaṃ.
pe4:7.3: yathā asukena bhāsitanti, taṃ suttaṃ vīmaṃsitabbaṃ:
pe4:7.4: kiṃ nu kho imaṃ suttaṃ anuññātaṃ khamaṃ bhagavato udāhu nānuññātaṃ khamaṃ, kiñci rūpaṃ ca suttaṃ bhagavato anuññātaṃ khamaṃ, kiñci rūpaṃ ca nānuññātaṃ khamaṃ
pe4:7.5: yaṃ sabbaso anotāretvā dasabalo gocaraṃ deseti, taṃ sabbaṃ suttaṃ bhagavato nānuññātaṃ khamaṃ.
pe4:7.6: atthipi so sāvako dasabalānaṃ gocaraṃ jānāti odhiso anodhiso, taṃ pana balaṃ sabbaso na jānāti aññathā nāma savanena? yathā āyasmatā sāriputtena yena brāhmaṇo ovadito, tassa āyasmato natthi indriyabalavemattañāṇaṃ, tena puggalaparopariyaṃ ca, taṃ ajānanto sati uttariṃ karaṇīye uppādito, so bhagavatā apasādito.
pe4:7.7: yathāva āyasmā kassapagotto cetaṃ ovadati ānantariyasamannāgato iddhipāṭihīrena aṅguliyo ādīpetvā, yaṃ sabbesaṃ dhammānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ hetuso ṭhānaso yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ. tassa āyasmato na saṃvijjate, tena naṃ ovadati, taṃ bhagavā karoti.
pe4:9.1: api’ca kho yathā dūto rājavacanena sattamanussāti, evaṃ sesānugo aññātakaṃ ghosaṃ paresaṃ deseti
pe4:10.2: pañcavidhaṃ suttaṃ: saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ vāsanābhāgiyaṃ dassanabhāgiyaṃ bhāvanābhāgiyaṃ asekhabhāgiyaṃ.
pe4:10.3: aññaṃ ārādheyya aññaṃ deseti aññassa ca suttassa atthaṃ aññamhi sutte niddisati,
pe4:10.9: iti idaṃ suttaṃ sambhedaṃ hetunā ca nissandena ca phalena ca niddessana ca, mudumajjhādhimattatāyapi ca anthena ca byañjanena ca yo sambhedo, ayaṃ vuccati suttasaṅkaro
